title: SS officers, Freemasons and occultists running NASA

tellings.quote: So, by the mid-1960s, the structure of NASA, and I mean the actual power structure, was a strange cocktail of former SS officers, Freemasons, and occultists.

plain: Michels argues that by the mid-1960s the people really running NASA were "a strange cocktail of former SS officers, Freemasons, and occultists." He offers it as his own reading of the agency's history and names, along the way, astronauts such as John Glenn, Buzz Aldrin, Edgar Mitchell and James Irwin, as well as the NASA chief James Webb and the NASA manager Kenneth Kleinknecht, without the quote saying which of them belongs to which group. If true, the space programme was shaped by hidden loyalties and beliefs far stranger than its public image.
